title: FERC General Correspondence — Docket P-4784-000: Letter to Brookfield Renewable Power regarding the 08/20/2026, Dam Safety Inspection for the Pejepscot Project under P-4784.
text:
FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
Office of Energy Projects
Division of Dam Safety and Inspections – New York Regional Office
September 1, 2026
VIA Electronic Mail
Randall Dorman
Senior Manager, Compliance
Brookfield Renewable Power
Randy.Dorman@brookfieldrenewable.com
Re: Letter to Brookfield Renewable Power regarding the August 20, 2026, Dam Safety
Inspection for the Pejepscot Project under P-4784
Dear Mr. Dorman:
Thank you for the assistance that was provided during the 2026 dam safety
inspection of the Pejepscot project, conducted by Lori Gale. No dam safety deficiencies
that require immediate attention were observed.
The status of your annual submittals is noted in Enclosure 1. Thank you for your
cooperation and commitment to dam safety.
Please note that we may have additional comments that arise during preparation of
our inspection report. If you have any questions, please contact Ms. Lori Gale of this office
at (212) 273-5909 or email at lori.gale@ferc.gov.
Sincerely,
John Spain, P.E.
Regional Engineer
Enclosure 1: Status of Annual Submissions

Enclosure 1: Status of Annual Submissions P-4784
Annual Status Update – Part 12D Recommendations:
 We requested a status update for recommendations and comments stemming from
the 6th and 7th Part 12D reports by letter dated June 12, 2026. The Licensee
responded by letter dated August 24, 2026. A table attached to that letter provided
the status of the 6th Part 12D recommendations. Open recommendations concerning
STID updates, surveys, and inspections, are expected to be resolved by upcoming
STID and DSSMP updates by December 31, 2026. Resolution of recommendations
concerning repairs at the left toe of the spillway is in progress.
 NYRO’s only comment on the 6th Part 12D report, which requested stability analysis
of the spillway using the gravity method, is supplanted by our comments on the 7th
Part 12D report.
 The 7th Part 12D inspection was a Periodic Inspection. The Periodic Inspection
Report (PIR) was submitted on December 19, 2025. There were 9 Independent
Consultant (IC) recommendations. In their August 24, 2026, letter the Licensee
stated that there has been no change in the status of the 7th Part 12D
recommendations since the Licensee’s plan and schedule letter of February 5, 2026.
The 7th Part 12D IC recommendations are expected to be resolved by the upcoming
STID and DSSMP updates and completion of repairs at the left toe of the spillway.
 NYRO provided comments on the 7th Part 12D PIR by letter dated March 18, 2026.
The Licensee provided an acceptable response by letter dated May 15, 2026.
Resolution of open NYRO comments is in progress with the Licensee’s ongoing
design of repairs to the left toe of the spillway and revised stability analysis, which
is expected by April 15, 2027.
Emergency Action Plan Requirements:
 An annual EAP status report was submitted on December 31, 2025. The report
satisfies Section 6-2.2.6 of our Engineering Guidelines.
 The most recent 5-year EAP reprint is dated December 2024. The most recent EAP
update was received on January 12, 2026. The EAP submittals conform to Chapter
6 of our engineering guidelines.
Dam Safety Performance Monitoring Program:
 The 2025 DSSMR was submitted on April 7, 2026, and accepted by letter dated
June 12, 2026. In that letter we requested clarifications on new survey procedures
that were recently adopted. The Licensee provided an acceptable response by letter
dated August 24, 2026. The letter stated that clarifications will be provided in the
updated DSSMP.
 The current DSSMP is dated March 2022. An updated DSSMP is expected by
December 31, 2026.
